steps.detail: Datagrid supports a checkbox prop (Datagrid.tsx:122), but ReportListRIP.tsx does not use it (0 occurrences of checkbox/select in the file) and ReportGridBase.tsx:19-32 just passes props without a checkbox. There is no ID selection column or state on the RIP screen; the only actions are Search and Export (ReportSlot.tsx:149-151).

steps.step: Letter dibuat hanya untuk ID yang dipilih
steps.detail: The RIP endpoints are only search (RipReportController.java:29) and xlsx export (:66); there is no generate-letter endpoint. The existing letter generation is POST /toppan/generate-letters without parameters, 'all stages' (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34-40), with no ID list and no knowledge of RIP. The executeJob() call in the scheduler is commented out (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118), so letters only run through the manual trigger.
